name: konark-app
description: Full rebuild of the Konark Energy site: React (Vite + Tailwind CSS v4) frontend, Node/Express backend, and Twilio SMS + WhatsApp notifications for new contact form inquiries. Same content, copy and images as the original site — new design, animation and stack.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
